targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM repositories WHERE is_active = true;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', c.commit_date) as time,
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  COUNT(*) as commits
FROM commits c
LEFT JOIN repositories r ON c.repo_id = r.repo_id
LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE c.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', c.commit_date), t.name
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', p.created_at) as time,
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  COUNT(*) as created
FROM pull_requests p
LEFT JOIN repositories r ON p.repo_id = r.repo_id
LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE p.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', p.created_at), t.name
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', p.merged_at) as time,
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  COUNT(*) as merged
FROM pull_requests p
LEFT JOIN repositories r ON p.repo_id = r.repo_id
LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE p.merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', p.merged_at), t.name
ORDER BY time, team;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', commit_date) as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) as contributors
FROM commits
WHERE commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', commit_date)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', commit_date) as time,
  SUM(lines_added) as added,
  SUM(lines_removed) as removed
FROM commits
WHERE commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', commit_date)
ORDER BY time;

SELECT 
  r.repo_id,
  r.name as repository,
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commits c WHERE c.repo_id = r.repo_id AND c.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as commits_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) FROM commits c WHERE c.repo_id = r.repo_id AND c.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as contributors_30d,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.repo_id = r.repo_id AND p.status = 'open') as open_prs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pull_requests p WHERE p.repo_id = r.repo_id AND p.merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as merged_prs_30d,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(v.id) FROM vulnerabilities v JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id WHERE d.repo_id = r.repo_id AND d.analyzed_at = (SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = r.repo_id)), 0) as vulnerabilities,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM branches b LEFT JOIN (SELECT branch_id, staleness_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn FROM branch_metrics) bm ON b.branch_id = bm.branch_id AND bm.rn = 1 WHERE b.repo_id = r.repo_id AND b.is_active = true AND COALESCE(bm.staleness_days, 999) > 30) as stale_branches,
  r.last_analyzed_at
FROM repositories r
LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (merged_at - created_at)) / 86400),
    0
  )::numeric(10,1) as days
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_at IS NOT NULL
  AND merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT 
  COALESCE(AVG(approval_count), 0)::numeric(10,1) as avg_approvals
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT COUNT(*) as prs_with_issues
FROM pull_requests
WHERE has_issues = true
  AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) as total_vulnerabilities
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
JOIN repositories r ON d.repo_id = r.repo_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = d.repo_id
  );

SELECT 
  COALESCE(size_category, 'unknown') as size,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM pull_requests
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY size_category;

SELECT 
  v.severity,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM vulnerabilities v
JOIN dependencies d ON v.dependency_id = d.id
JOIN repositories r ON d.repo_id = r.repo_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND d.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM dependencies WHERE repo_id = d.repo_id
  )
GROUP BY v.severity
ORDER BY 
  CASE v.severity 
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 
  END;

SELECT 
  language,
  SUM(line_count) as lines
FROM repository_languages rl
JOIN repositories r ON rl.repo_id = r.repo_id
WHERE r.is_active = true
  AND rl.analyzed_at = (
    SELECT MAX(analyzed_at) FROM repository_languages WHERE repo_id = rl.repo_id
  )
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY lines DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as contributor,
  COUNT(cm.commit_sha) as commits
FROM contributors c
JOIN commits cm ON c.id = cm.author_id
WHERE cm.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY commits DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as reviewer,
  COUNT(r.id) as reviews
FROM contributors c
JOIN pr_reviews r ON c.id = r.reviewer_id
WHERE r.review_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.email
ORDER BY reviews DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.repo_id) as repositories,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as contributors,
  COUNT(cm.commit_sha) as commits_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.status = 'open' THEN p.id END) as open_prs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.merged_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN p.id END) as merged_prs_30d,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.merged_at - p.created_at)) / 86400), 1) as avg_merge_time_days
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN repositories r ON t.team_id = r.team_id
LEFT JOIN commits cm ON r.repo_id = cm.repo_id AND cm.commit_date > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
LEFT JOIN contributors c ON cm.author_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN pull_requests p ON r.repo_id = p.repo_id
WHERE COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
GROUP BY t.team_id, t.name
ORDER BY commits_30d DESC;

SELECT 
  r.repo_id,
  r.name as repository,
  COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') as team,
  pr.pr_number as "PR #",
  pr.title,
  COALESCE(c.name, c.email) as author,
  pr.status,
  pr.size_category as size,
  pr.files_changed as files,
  pr.approval_count as approvals,
  pr.created_at
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN repositories r ON pr.repo_id = r.repo_id
LEFT JOIN teams t ON r.team_id = t.team_id
LEFT JOIN contributors c ON pr.author_id = c.id
WHERE pr.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(t.name, 'No Team') IN (${team:singlequote})
ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC
LIMIT 25;
